ScribeCat 0.28.1 improves linked blocks and split view.

- Linked Markdown blocks can be edited directly. The content uses the visual editor, including tables, images and PDFs, and edits update the source note. A subtle outline and small path label identify the source.
- Long press a table cell on mobile to open its row and column actions.
- Dragging a note or tab into split view replaces only the pane where it is dropped.
